name: Multi-Space Work Item Creation
type: AM Platform / Construction dashboard / Notion work items

dataIsolation.guard: Every selected space is loaded from the tenant-local Spaces data source and validated against the selected project before any Work Item is created.

definitionOfDone: The Work Item form supports selecting one, many, or all spaces in the current project
One Notion Work Item is created per selected space
All selected spaces are validated before the first write
Existing same-name work items in a selected space are skipped during retries
Single-space API payloads remain backward compatible
Gantt labels identify the related space for repeated work-item names
Gantt and space-by-trade matrix refresh after bulk creation
Syntax, mock Notion write, package, and alignment verification pass
Production Render deployment and live UI proof are recorded before status becomes Deployed
